title: Galardell Valley
wikitext:
[[Image:Galardell Valley.jpg|thumb|300px|Galardell Valley]]

'''Galardell Valley''' is located in the northeastern part of the [[Redridge Mountains]]. It is the location of the infamous [[Tower of Ilgalar]] where the evil [[Morganth]] dwells. The valley is crawling with [[gnoll]]s, and the most powerful of these is [[Lieutenant Fangore]], who can dispatch an unprepared group of adventurers by calling to the nearby gnolls for help.
